title: When the Confession Wakes
author: Tamsin Galloway
blurb: Quentin Eastwick, a small-town coroner who knows every grave by name, thought they had seen every way a life can end. Then a body turns up dressed in clothes stolen from the witness's own closet — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
